architecture: C++17 + Qt6 Widgets + OpenCV + Eigen3 (ORB-SLAM3 / Pangolin native & Docker backend)
target: Windows 10/11 x64 (MSYS2 CLANG64) and Ubuntu 22.04+ x86_64
software_backend: Native ORB-SLAM3 C++ runner (umi_slam_runner) with relocatable backend.json, plus pure-C++ umi-slam:0.1 Docker fallback
trajectory_origin: IMU body (optional target frame export when valid T_imu_target is configured)

images.notes: Rebuilt pure-C++ Ubuntu 22.04 image via software/umi_slam/build_docker.sh

validation.cpp_tests: test_pipeline_cpp and test_station_cpp via CTest; covers MS901M decoding, timestamp precision, non-ASCII UTF-8 paths, ORB-SLAM3 patching & isolated backend staging, checksum verification, Docker/native cancellation, Kalibr conversion, synthetic stereo+IMU calibration, and zero-cross-dependency checks
validation.native_backend: Isolated C++ --build-backend builds Pangolin, DBoW2, g2o, ORB_SLAM3, and umi_slam_runner with relocatable backend.json
validation.docker_backend: Pure-C++ umi-slam:0.1 image builds and prints CLI usage cleanly; full sequence trajectory accuracy certification requires real capture regression
validation.kalibr: Retains ROS1 container helper scripts under calibration/tools/ and calibration/build/ invoked via calibration/kalibr.sh
